name: VibeVoice
one_liner: A free, high-quality AI voice engine that can read text aloud in a natural-sounding voice, or transcribe speech back into text.
buyer: An audiobook or online-course creator who wants professional-sounding narration without paying for a voice actor or studio time.
business_use_cases: A self-publishing audiobook platform narrates books in multiple voices affordably instead of hiring voice actors per title.
A course creator turns written lesson scripts into narrated video lessons cheaply, cutting production cost per course.
A customer-support company builds a low-cost multilingual voice assistant for phone support using the TTS and transcription stack together.

money_ideas.idea: Subscription 'narrate your blog or book' web app charged per month.
Usage-based API resell margin for a hosted narration endpoint.

steal_this: Build a simple web app this weekend: paste in a blog post, pick a voice, get back a narrated MP3 — charge $9/month for unlimited narrations.
